items.title: Your artist website and store
items.description: An artist-first home for your work, with a connected store and one place to manage it. Explore the direction and what is available now.

sections.title: Your work. Your identity.
sections.text: Your artist page brings your biography, music, releases and public links together. Studio is where you manage your artist information and choose what to share. Publishing requires an approved username and your choice to make the profile public; creating an account alone does not publish your information or establish a label partnership.

sections.title: A website and a store, connected
sections.text:
Your artist website tells the story of your work. Your store presents the things you offer: releases, editions and merchandise. They serve different purposes, but should feel like parts of the same artist identity.

We are developing a shared storefront system that keeps those experiences connected without turning your public website into an administration panel.

sections.title: Manage your work in Studio
sections.text:
Studio is the management space; your public page is the presentation. You can manage your profile and prepare private release and store drafts there. Private drafts are not public products or a live shop.

The planned store tools will bring products, collections, variants, inventory, orders, delivery, reporting and domain settings into that same workspace. These capabilities are being developed in stages; they are not all available today.

sections.title: One store. More than one address.
sections.text:
The planned Artanrecords storefront address is artanrecords.com/{username}/shop/. A verified custom domain would provide another address for that same store, not a second product catalogue, inventory or set of earnings.

Your artist identity and store records should stay connected even if your domain changes. The Artanrecords address is intended to remain a platform fallback, with any preferred-domain routing handled as part of a reviewed setup.

sections.title: Use your own domain
sections.text:
Custom domains are planned for artist websites and stores. Connecting one will require ownership verification, secure hosting setup and an agreed migration plan. Domain registration, renewals and responsibility for access must be agreed separately; a Studio account does not purchase or connect a domain.

If you already have a website or store, keep it running while the replacement is prepared and reviewed. No domain should move until the new experience, content and routing have been checked and the change has been approved.

sections.title: A shared platform. An individual presence.
sections.text: Your images, writing, releases, collections and visual choices belong to your artistic identity. The shared platform is being designed to support that individuality while providing consistent tools for managing and presenting the work. You should not need a separate administration system for every public address.

sections.title: What is available now
sections.text:
Studio supports accounts, artist-profile management and private release, product and collection drafts. Public artist pages use the information you explicitly select for publication on an approved profile.

Shared public shops, connected custom domains, checkout, order management and live earnings or withdrawals are not yet available. A payout application is a request for review, not confirmation of an active payment account. Prices, store revenue shares and withdrawal rules will need to be defined before those services launch; do not assume they follow recording partnership terms.

sections.title: Start with your artist profile
sections.text: Prepare your biography, images and public links in Studio. If you already run a website or store, you can discuss your existing setup with Artanrecords before making changes. Keep bank details, tax identifiers and identity documents out of public profiles and enquiry forms.

items.title: A label relationship, built around the work
items.description: Human review, artist-owned masters and zero upfront base distribution fees for accepted standard releases. Understand the scope before you submit.

sections.title: We listen first
sections.text: Artanrecords is a curated independent label, not an unrestricted upload distributor. We consider the music, the people behind it, rights readiness and whether we can support the project responsibly. An introduction, account or partnership preference does not create acceptance.

sections.title: What zero upfront means
sections.text: Accepted standard releases carry no upfront base distribution fee. It does not mean every service is free: additional production, artwork, advertising, external PR, domains and maintenance need an agreed scope and expense treatment. The written offer defines artist and label shares of eligible recording-side Net Receipts, permitted deductions and reporting. No payment is requested simply to introduce your work.

sections.title: Your master remains yours
sections.text: You retain ownership of the master recording. The agreement defines the licence Artanrecords needs to operate the release, its term, territory and permitted uses. Songwriting, publishing, live income and merchandise are not automatically included. Discuss notice, final reporting and migration before signing.

sections.title: Choose the involvement, not a promise of success
sections.text: Silver covers essential label infrastructure. Gold adds a defined release plan and presentation support. Platinum adds scoped project leadership and artist development. You may express a preference; we review fit and capacity before offering a scope. No tier guarantees streams, playlists, press coverage or income.

sections.title: A considered pace
sections.text: Artanrecords is founder-led. High-touch work is accepted only when there is capacity to deliver the agreed scope. We may discuss a later start, a narrower project or decline an introduction. Do not assume availability or a release date until confirmed.

sections.title: Discover. Understand. Work.
sections.text: The website is for discovering the label, comparing partnerships and sharing work. Docs explains requirements and responsibilities. Studio provides profile and website editing, visual projects, private release materials and release submission for label review. Production signing, financial reporting and payouts require separate activation. Opening an account does not approve an artist relationship.

items.title: Bring your expertise
items.description: Project collaboration with Artanrecords: clear roles, scope and terms before any work begins.

sections.title: A project, not an undefined opportunity
sections.text: We welcome relevant introductions in design, photography, release operations, music marketing, web presentation and other specialist work. This page is not a list of open jobs or an invitation to provide unpaid speculative work.

sections.title: Agree the arrangement first
sections.text: For a real project, confirm the contracting parties, engagement type, deliverables, schedule, revisions, compensation, payment timing, expenses, rights and cancellation arrangements before work starts. Employment, freelance work, advisory work and collaboration are different arrangements; none is implied by an enquiry.

sections.title: A relevant introduction is enough
sections.text: Share your area of expertise, availability, portfolio link and the type of engagement you are seeking. Do not send identity documents, bank details, private client work or a completed speculative assignment. We discuss a brief only if there is a suitable project.

items.title: How can we help?
items.description: Find artist guidance, partnership details and the right contact for your question.

sections.title: Getting started
sections.text: Read the release guidance or learn how to send your work for consideration.

sections.title: Partnerships and agreements
sections.text: Compare Silver, Gold and Platinum, then read how scope, responsibilities and financial terms are agreed. A partnership preference is not an accepted agreement.

sections.title: Using Studio
sections.text: Find guidance for the artist workspace. Account access and financial services depend on their connected services; no guide replaces a signed agreement.

items.title: Good music brings people together
items.description: Introduce an artist to Artanrecords. A referral programme for creative services is being prepared.

sections.title: Know an artist we should hear?
sections.text: Point them toward our submission page. Every artist is considered on their work and the scope of a potential partnership, not on who introduced them. A referral never guarantees acceptance.

sections.title: More room for the work
sections.text: The planned programme would recognise qualifying artist introductions with credits toward approved promotion, artwork or website services. It is not open for earning or spending credits yet. Award values and qualifying milestones will be explained before launch.

sections.title: Clear from the beginning
sections.text: Programme terms will define eligibility, attribution, awards, redemption, expiry, cancellations and disputes. Service credits are separate from recording royalties and do not change a release agreement. Cash conversion and credit withdrawals are not currently available.

sections.title: Start with the music
sections.text: Artists can explore our partnerships and share a listening link without paying an upfront base distribution fee for an accepted standard release. Additional services require an agreed scope. No one needs to join a referral programme to be considered.

items.title: Human music. Human artists.
items.description: Our requirements for recordings, artwork and artist profile photographs.

sections.title: Human-made recordings
sections.text: Artanrecords does not accept fully AI-generated music or masters. We work with human-made music and human creative performance. Describe how the recording was made and disclose AI involvement so we can review its role; uncertainty is discussed before a release is accepted.

sections.title: Artwork is reviewed separately
sections.text: Using AI in release artwork is not, by itself, a reason for rejection. You must have the necessary rights and permissions, disclose AI-generated elements and meet the artwork requirements of the release and its delivery services. Do not use artwork that misrepresents another person or infringes their rights.

sections.title: Real people in artist profiles
sections.text: Artist profile photographs must show the real artist. AI-generated portraits, synthetic identities and face replacements are not accepted as artist profile images. Provide a photograph you are authorised to use; ordinary photographic editing must not misrepresent the person.

sections.title: A considered review
sections.text: We review the recording, credits and the creative process. We may ask for contributor confirmation, session information, stems or other relevant provenance through an agreed private process. A detection score alone is not treated as conclusive proof of authorship.

sections.title: If something needs clarification
sections.text: We may pause a submission and ask questions before proceeding. An artist can explain the tools used and provide supporting information. Do not send private session files or sensitive documents through the public enquiry form.

items.title: Privacy policy
items.description: Draft privacy policy for Artanrecords. Not approved for publication.

sections.title: Who operates Artanrecords
sections.text: Artanrecords is currently operated by Artan Davoodi (legal name: Saeed Davoodi). Artanrecords is not currently a registered company. Privacy enquiries can be sent to contact@artanrecords.com.

sections.title: Information you provide
sections.text: The enquiry form collects your name, artist or project name, reply email, purpose, optional website, social and listening links, and your message. It records your acknowledgement, a submission reference and the time of receipt.

sections.title: Why it is used
sections.text: Information is used to review your work, respond to your enquiry and protect the form from abuse. Sending an enquiry does not subscribe you to marketing or create an artist account.

sections.title: Services involved
sections.text: The website is hosted on GitHub Pages. Enquiries are processed through Google Apps Script, stored in a private Google Sheet and notified to an iCloud-hosted inbox. Opening the form loads Google reCAPTCHA. These providers may process technical information under their own terms.

sections.title: Browser preferences and links
sections.text: The website stores your appearance preference in browser storage. Following an external listening or social link takes you to another service, whose privacy policy applies there.

sections.title: Proposed retention rule
sections.text: Proposed for implementation: remove unsuccessful enquiries from the active enquiry sheet and collaboration mailbox within 30 days after a recorded decline or closure. Active conversations require a separate review date. This rule is not yet represented as an operating deletion guarantee.

sections.title: Your requests
sections.text: Contact contact@artanrecords.com to ask about access, correction or deletion of information you submitted. Applicable rights, exceptions and the appropriate supervisory authority must be confirmed before this draft becomes the published policy.

sections.title: Publication review required
sections.text: Before publication, confirm the operator contact address, applicable processing grounds, provider transfer arrangements, retention implementation, rights procedure and any legally required disclosures. This draft is not a legal compliance certification.

items.title: Around the music
items.description: Release preparation, catalog presentation and collaboration at Artanrecords.

sections.title: Release preparation
sections.text: Music, artwork, credits and metadata belong together. We work with selected projects to prepare a coherent release. The scope of each engagement is agreed individually.

sections.title: A lasting home
sections.text: Our public catalog brings recordings, artists, credits and listening links together in one place. Each approved artist and release has a dedicated page.

sections.title: Creative collaboration
sections.text: Sound and visual work can develop together. Bring a recording, an image or an idea. Creative support is discussed for each project, not promised as a standard package.

sections.title: Clear scope
sections.text: An enquiry is not an agreement. Distribution arrangements, responsibilities and any commercial terms must be confirmed before work begins. We do not guarantee promotion, playlist placement or commercial results.

items.title: Submit your music
items.description: A recording. A little context. A conversation about what comes next.
items.headline:
Your music
Let us hear it
items.processLabel: Three steps to share your work
items.conversationDescription: Introduce yourself, add a listening link if you have one, and tell us what you want to make next. Music submission is already selected in the form.
items.notice: Human-made music only: fully AI-generated music or masters are not accepted. Artist profile photographs must show the real artist, not an AI-generated person. AI-assisted artwork is reviewed separately. Sending work does not guarantee acceptance or a release.

sections.title: Let us hear the work
sections.text: Introduce the artist behind the recording. Share a listening link and tell us whether it is a single, EP or album, who contributed, and what you hope to release.
sections.detail: A private streaming link is enough. Keep masters and project files with you.

sections.title: A considered review
sections.text: We listen and read the context you share. Each enquiry is considered individually, with the recording and your intentions at the centre of the conversation.
sections.detail: If there is a fit, we can discuss the project. Submission is not acceptance or a release agreement.

sections.title: A clear next step
sections.text: Open the form below, introduce yourself and tell us what you are looking for. Share only work and links you have permission to send.
sections.detail: No attachments are needed. Do not include identity documents, bank details or tax information.

items.title: Make something together
items.description: Connect with Artanrecords about sound, visual work and creative collaboration.

sections.title: Start with an idea
sections.text: For musicians, producers, composers, filmmakers, photographers, designers and aligned organisations. Tell us what you do, what you have in mind and where we can see or hear your work.

sections.title: A direct conversation
sections.text: Choose Collaboration in the form below. A concise introduction and a relevant portfolio link are enough to begin. Scope, responsibilities and terms are discussed individually.

items.title: Before you send
items.description: Practical answers for artists contacting Artanrecords.

sections.title: Who can get in touch?
sections.text: Artists and people authorised to represent their work can send an introduction. Creative collaborators can use the collaboration page.

sections.title: What is Artanrecords Studio?
sections.text: Artanrecords Studio is the online artist workspace at studio.artanrecords.com, not a physical recording studio. It provides artist-profile and supported website editing, brand graphics, Gallery and Projects, catalogue links and private release preparation for label review. It is not an instant self-service distribution service.

sections.title: How can I verify an Artanrecords message?
sections.text: Use artanrecords.com for official label information, studio.artanrecords.com for your workspace and docs.artanrecords.com for guidance. Check a claimed offer against these official channels and ask the label through its published contact page if anything is unclear. A logo, display name or search result is not proof of identity. Never send passwords, payment-card details or identity documents through a public enquiry form.

sections.title: How should I decide whether Studio is right for me?
sections.text: Consider whether you need one workspace for your artist presentation, supported page editing, visual projects and private release materials. Compare the tools available today with your workflow, the published software prices and any access included in a verified active partnership. Do not purchase on the assumption that future financial, commerce or signing features are already active. Studio is a different service from an immediate upload-and-distribute platform.

sections.title: Do I need to send audio files?
sections.text: A listening link is enough for an initial enquiry. The public form does not accept file uploads. Keep masters and project files private.

sections.title: Does a submission mean acceptance?
sections.text: No. Every enquiry is reviewed. Any offer of representation or release arrangement must be agreed separately.

sections.title: Is promotion included?
sections.text: Do not assume it is. Creative or promotional support, where offered, is agreed for the individual project. There are no guarantees of streams, placement or coverage.

sections.title: Does sending work create an artist account?
sections.text: No. Sending an enquiry does not create an account or establish a label partnership. You can create a Studio account separately; a public artist page requires an approved username and your choice to publish selected information.

sections.title: Can I manage my website and store in Studio?
sections.text: You can manage your artist profile and prepare private release, product and collection drafts. Shared public shops, custom-domain connections, checkout and live payouts are still in development. The planned system connects your public artist presence and store to one Studio workspace without duplicating your catalogue.

sections.title: Where are commercial terms explained?
sections.text: Commercial terms must be discussed and agreed before an engagement. There is no universal royalty percentage or payout schedule published on this website.

sections.title: What happens after I send an enquiry?
sections.text: The confirmation gives your submission reference. We aim to respond within 14 working days; this is a review target, not a guaranteed deadline. Artanrecords reviews introductions individually and may contact you about the work and possible next steps. A receipt is not acceptance or a release commitment.

sections.title: How do I correct something I submitted?
sections.text: Email the collaboration inbox with your enquiry reference, if available, and explain the correction. You do not need to submit the whole enquiry again. Do not include private masters, identity documents or payment details.

sections.title: Where can I read the release guidance?
sections.text: Our documentation explains the current enquiry process, release workflow and preparation of audio, artwork and metadata. Project-specific delivery requirements and agreements take precedence over general guidance.

items.title: Legal information
items.description: The scope of public information and enquiries at Artanrecords.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
sections.text:
Browser local storage retains your Cookies & preferences choice for up to 180 days so the website can respect it. If you allow optional preference storage, it also remembers your appearance. Skip leaves optional appearance storage off, and you can change your choice through the footer.

Opening an enquiry form loads Google reCAPTCHA for necessary spam and abuse protection; that service can use verification cookies and processes browser and interaction information. Submitting an enquiry does not subscribe you to marketing. External listening and social services apply their own cookie notices when you visit them.

sections.title: Enquiries, not agreements
sections.text:
The public form is an introduction to Artanrecords: a way to share a recording, describe a project or propose a collaboration. It begins a review and a possible conversation, not a contractual relationship.

Submitting an enquiry does not create an artist account, an offer of representation, a distribution agreement or an approved artist profile. A receipt confirmation means your enquiry was received; it does not mean your work has been accepted.

Tell us who you are, what you are sharing and what you would like to discuss. Use listening or portfolio links rather than private masters or sensitive documents. If you represent someone else, explain your role and share only information you are authorised to provide.

Any proposed engagement needs its own discussion and agreement before work begins. Do not assume that a submission includes distribution, promotion, playlist placement or commercial results.

sections.title: Respect the work
sections.text:
Share only recordings, images, lyrics, credits and other material you are authorised to share. A publicly accessible link does not by itself establish permission to use or release the material.

Identify collaborators and any known third-party contributions, including samples, cover compositions, photographs and artwork. Explain any permissions that still need to be resolved rather than presenting them as confirmed. Do not submit confidential material belonging to another person.

The public catalogue presents approved release information and links to listening services. Access to an image or recording through this website is not a statement that it is free to reuse, redistribute or adapt. For permission questions, contact the relevant rights holder or ask Artanrecords to help identify the appropriate contact.

For a credit correction or rights concern, email contact@artanrecords.com with the release link, the material concerned, your relationship to it and a clear explanation. Avoid sending identity documents or unrelated personal information in the initial message.

sections.title: Project terms
sections.text:
Each engagement needs a clear scope suited to the project. This website describes the label and its enquiry process; it is not the agreement governing a release or collaboration.

Before work begins, the parties should clarify the services involved, responsibilities, deliverables, approvals and any proposed timetable. Rights ownership and any permission to distribute or use recordings, compositions, artwork or an artist identity must be addressed expressly.

Where relevant, the project discussion should also cover costs, revenue allocation, reporting, payment arrangements, duration and how the engagement may end. These are subjects for a project-specific agreement, not standard terms promised by this page.

Artanrecords does not publish a universal royalty percentage, payout schedule or promotion guarantee here. Ask for clarification of anything you do not understand before accepting an agreement, and seek independent legal or accounting advice where appropriate.

sections.title: Personal information
sections.text:
Artist enquiries ask for contact details and project information so Artanrecords can review the work and respond. Provide only what is relevant to that conversation, and obtain permission before including another person's private information.

Do not use the public enquiry form to send identity documents, bank details, tax information, private contracts or confidential masters. Secure onboarding for sensitive information is not provided by this public website.

The submission privacy notice explains the current form process, including the services used to handle enquiries and verification. External streaming and social links take you to other services, where their own notices and settings apply.

For a question about information you submitted, or to request a correction or deletion, contact contact@artanrecords.com and describe the enquiry using information you already shared. Do not send additional sensitive documents unless an appropriate process has been agreed. This overview does not replace the submission privacy notice or a project-specific agreement.
